preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int, type(int)) for int in [T]) and T >= 1 and T <= 1000
preconditions.description: T is an integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive, representing the number of test cases.
Each test case line contains exactly two integers N and K.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(N) <= 10**5 and 1 <= int(K) <= int(N) for N, K in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]))
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive, and K is an integer between 1 and N inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_line.split()) == int(N) for output_line, N in zip(stdout.splitlines(), (line.split()[0] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])) if output_line != '-1')
postconditions.description: For each test case where a valid permutation exists, the output line contains exactly N integers representing the permutation P.

postconditions.expression: all(set(output_line.split()) == set(range(1, int(N)+1)) for output_line, N in zip(stdout.splitlines(), (line.split()[0] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])) if output_line != '-1')
postconditions.description: For each test case where a valid permutation exists, the output line is a permutation of the integers from 1 to N.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(1 for i in range(1, int(N)+1) if int(P[i-1]) % i == 0) == int(K) for P, N, K in zip(stdout.splitlines(), (line.split()[0] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]), (line.split()[1] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])) if P != '-1')
postconditions.description: For each test case where a valid permutation exists, exactly K indices i (1-based) in the permutation P satisfy P[i] % i == 0.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line == '-1' or (all(1 <= int(x) <= int(N) for x in output_line.split()) and len(set(output_line.split())) == int(N)) for output_line, N in zip(stdout.splitlines(), (line.split()[0] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])))
postconditions.description: For each test case where no valid permutation exists, the output line is '-1'.
